name: noaa-marine-mcp-server
description: Find NOAA tide stations and NDBC buoys, fetch tide predictions, currents, and live conditions.

NOAA_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp limits
NOAA_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Clamp a limit above its cap (1000 rows on the series tools, 200 stations on noaa_marine_find_stations) to the cap with a notice. Set false to advertise and enforce each cap as a schema maximum instead. Leave blank for true.
